pretreatments.description: CaO2 oxidation combined with MW irradiation. 450 mL of sludge were first mixed well with CaO2 for 2 min, then exposed to MW irradiation, after which the treated sludge samples were cooled to room temperature for subsequent use. The dosages of CaO2 were 0.05, 0.1, and 0.2 g/gVSS. MW power was 160, 320, and 480 W, and MW irradiation time was 2, 4, and 6 min.
MW irradiation (480 W, 2 min) combined with H2O2. The dosages of H2O2 were 0.048 g/gVSS. CaO_2 and Ca(OH)_2 were added to the sludge samples to produce H_2O_2.
MW irradiation (480 W, 2 min) combined with Ca(OH)2. The dosages of Ca(OH)_2 were 0.05 g/gVSS.
MW irradiation (480 W, 2 min) combined with CaO2. The dosages of CaO2 were 0.05, 0.1, and 0.2 g/gVSS.
Sole MW treatment. MW power was 480 W and MW irradiation time was 2 min.
CaO2 treatment. The dosages of CaO2 were 0.05, 0.1, and 0.2 g/gVSS.
Ca(OH)2 treatment. The dosages of Ca(OH)2 were 0.05 g/gVSS.
H2O2 treatment. The dosages of H2O2 were 0.048 g/gVSS.
